description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClawKit UI components, particularly for Canvas A2 UI commands and JSONL message decoding/validation.

classes.name: CanvasA2UITests
classes.description: Unit test suite for Canvas A2 UI features, verifying stability of command strings and JSONL message handling.

methods.name: commandStringsAreStable
methods.description: Verifies that the raw string values for specific UI commands remain consistent.

methods.name: jsonlDecodesAndValidatesV0_8
methods.description: Tests decoding and validation of JSONL messages conforming to version 0.8.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsV0_9CreateSurface
methods.description: Ensures that creating a surface with an unsupported version (v0.9) is rejected.

methods.name: jsonlRejectsUnknownShape
methods.description: Tests that JSONL messages with unknown shapes are properly rejected.
